title: if i could be in 2 places …
excerpt: I leave in a few hours for a week in Scotland and England … I hope to meet many readers and make many new friends there! If I could be in 2 places at once, I’d also be in Memphis, where The Great Emergence event is underway. The EV blog is carrying updates here.
body:
I leave in a few hours for a week in Scotland and England … I hope to meet many readers and make many new friends there!

If I could be in 2 places at once, I’d also be in Memphis, where The Great Emergence event is underway. The EV blog is carrying updates here.
